page.overview:
Who is Whitewash?

Whitewash is a male background Pegasus pony with a white coat, blue mane and tail, gold eyes, and a cutie mark of a purple umbrella. He is unnamed in the show, but he is named in merchandise.

Whitewash shares his design with Rainbow Swoop, "Thorn", Cerulean Skies, Prism Glider, Rainbow Blaze, and his mane and tail style with Red Delicious, Coco Crusoe, "Welch", Goldengrape, Noteworthy, "Baritone", "Cherry Strudel", Felix, "Harry Trotter", Apple Cinnamon, "Grape Crush", S04E06 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, S04E08 Unnamed Earth Stallion #2, S04E08 Unnamed Earth Stallion #8, S04E08 Unnamed Earth Stallion #13, S04E20 Unnamed Earth Stallion #4, S04E20 Unnamed Earth Stallion #6, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #8, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #11, S04E24 Unnamed Earth Stallion #8, M2 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, and S05E09 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1.

Whitewash's name and collectible card game quote allude to the Firefly character Hoban "Wash" Washburne.

Whitewash appears later in Hurricane Fluttershy as one of the participating Pegasi to transport water to Cloudsdale.
